description: Map the late-expressed T5 nickase against early D15 and the interruption sites; update the evidence matrix and GO decision table artifacts
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
outdir="/agent/jobs/0cf15093-9d08-4baf-925b-56add648ad8e/provenance"
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
gb=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi", params={"db":"nuccore","id":"AY587007.1","rettype":"gb","retmode":"text"}, timeout=120).text
GL=121752
feats=re.split(r"\n(?=     (?:CDS|gene)  )", gb[gb.index("FEATURES"):gb.index("\nORIGIN")])
rows=[]
for f in feats:
    s=f.strip()
    if not s.startswith("CDS"): continue
    loc=re.match(r"CDS\s+(\S+)",s).group(1); nums=[int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+",loc)]
    if not nums: continue
    def q(n):
        m=re.search(r'/%s="([^"]*)"'%n,f,re.S); return re.sub(r"\s+"," ",m.group(1)) if m else ""
    rows.append(dict(start=min(nums),end=max(nums),strand="-" if "complement" in loc else "+",
                     gene=q("gene"),prod=q("product"),pid=q("protein_id")))
cds=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("start").reset_index(drop=True)
cds["pct"]=100*(cds.start+cds.end)/2/GL
LATE=r"capsid|portal|terminase|tail|head|scaffold|baseplate|fib(re|er)|holin|neck|collar|prohead|decoration|receptor.binding"
cds["late"]=cds["prod"].str.contains(LATE,case=False,regex=True,na=False)
late=cds[cds.late]
print("late/virion CDS:", len(late), "| span %.1f-%.1f%%" % (late.pct.min(), late.pct.max()))

D15_PCT=66.23; NICK_PCT=86.77
nicks={"7.9":7.9,"18.5":18.5,"32.6":32.6,"64.8":64.8,"99.6":99.6}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,3.8))
ax.hlines(0,0,100,color="0.8",lw=4,zorder=0)
ax.plot(cds[~cds.late].pct,[0.28]*(~cds.late).sum(),"|",color="#4C78A8",ms=8,
        label="other CDS (n=%d)"%(~cds.late).sum())
ax.plot(late.pct,[-0.28]*len(late),"|",color="#E45756",ms=12,
        label="virion / morphogenesis CDS (late class, n=%d)"%len(late))
ax.axvspan(late.pct.quantile(.10), late.pct.quantile(.90), color="#E45756", alpha=0.10, zorder=-1)
for k,v in nicks.items():
    ax.axvline(v,color="#54A24B",ls="--",lw=1.6,zorder=1)
    ax.text(v,0.78,k+"%",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#2E6B2B")
ax.annotate("D15 (early)\nflap endonuclease", xy=(D15_PCT,0), xytext=(D15_PCT-13,-0.92),
            fontsize=9, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="black",lw=1.2))
ax.annotate("nickase ORF142 / Q6QGD4 (late)\nmakes the interruptions", xy=(NICK_PCT,0), xytext=(NICK_PCT-20,0.95),
            fontsize=9, color="#B3401F", arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#B3401F",lw=1.2))
ax.plot([D15_PCT],[0],"o",color="black",ms=7,zorder=3)
ax.plot([NICK_PCT],[0],"o",color="#B3401F",ms=7,zorder=3)
ax.set_xlim(0,100); ax.set_ylim(-1.25,1.25); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("position on T5 genome AY587007 (% of 121,752 bp)")
ax.set_title("The enzyme that makes the T5 interruptions is a late gene; D15 is early and 20.5% away")
ax.legend(loc="lower left",fontsize=8,frameon=False)
for sp in ["left","right","top"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# --- update artifact tables ---
ev=pd.read_csv(f"{outdir}/evidence_matrix_D15_late_transcription.csv")
new=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(pmid="24198424 + UniProt Q6QGD4", year=2014, type="database/proteomic + computational (this work)", stance="refutes",
      claim="D15-dependent nicks license late promoters",
      finding="The nickase is Q6QGD4 / ORF142 (145 aa), UniProt INDUCTION 'expressed in the late phase'; maps to 105,428-105,865 (86.8%), inside the late morphogenesis cluster beside the portal protein. Nicks are therefore made after late transcription starts",
      context="UniProt annotation + CDS mapping on AY587007",
      confidence="Moderate-high. INDUCTION is a database annotation; genomic position inside the late cluster is an independent computed check"),
 dict(pmid="19592061", year=2009, type="direct assay (related phage)", stance="refutes",
      claim="Interruptions pre-exist and license late transcription",
      finding="In phikF77, the localized nicks 'are introduced into the phage DNA at late stages of the lytic cycle'",
      context="Pseudomonas phage phikF77, phiKMV-like genus",
      confidence="Moderate. Different phage family; shows the timing is late where it has been measured"),
 dict(pmid="computed (sigma70 scan)", year=2026, type="computational (this work)", stance="refutes",
      claim="Interruptions are promoter-proximal",
      finding="156 predicted sigma70 promoters (<=2 mismatches, 1 per 780 bp). Median distance of the 5 interruptions to the nearest = 474 bp vs permutation null median 315 bp; one-sided p = 0.77",
      context="AY587007, both strands, 20,000 permutations",
      confidence="Moderate. Consensus-motif prediction is crude and the genome is saturated, limiting power"),
])
ev=pd.concat([ev,new],ignore_index=True)
ev.to_csv(f"{outdir}/evidence_matrix_D15_late_transcription.csv", index=False)
print("\nevidence matrix now", len(ev), "rows; stance tally:")
print(ev.groupby("stance").size().to_string())

go=pd.read_csv(f"{outdir}/go_decision_table_D15.csv")
go.loc[go.go_id=="GO:0019086","rationale"]=(go.loc[go.go_id=="GO:0019086","rationale"].iloc[0]
  + " Added iteration 2: the nickase that makes the interruptions is a LATE gene product (UniProt Q6QGD4 / ORF142, 86.8% of AY587007, beside the portal protein), so the proposed mark cannot precede the process it is said to license.")
go.to_csv(f"{outdir}/go_decision_table_D15.csv", index=False)
print("\nGO table updated. Files:", sorted(os.listdir(outdir)))
